blocks.x: I'll make a note here. The date is May 1st, 1961, and we're over at 731 St. Peter Street interviewing Bob Wilbur. Do you mind giving your full name? Do you have any middle initial or name? Robert Sage Wilbur. And do you mind telling just when you were born and where?
I was born March 15th, 1928, in New York City. Can you tell when you first became interested
in music? How old you were and what were the circumstances, if you remember?
